about.title: Learning support that follows every student
about.subtitle: Sanad is a complete digital platform for Algerian middle school, high school, and university students. Structured content, live revision sessions, and continuous support until exam day.
about.point1: Instantly join with the code inside your book
about.point2: Follow a personalized learning path with clear progress
about.point3: Attend live revision sessions over Zoom
about.point4: Ask teachers questions and get quick answers

services.title: Courses designed for every study path
services.subtitle: Whether you are preparing the BEM or the BAC, there is a track built for you.
services.middleDesc: Foundations and BEM preparation across all core subjects.
services.highDesc: Full program coverage with structured weekly revision.
services.universityDesc: First-year foundation modules and exam-focused tutoring for university students.
services.examDesc: Intensive BAC & BEM final revision with corrected past papers.

feedback.title: Students feel more confident after every lesson
feedback.subtitle: Real progress from clear lessons, interactive questions, and continuous performance tracking.
feedback.review1Body: Sanad helped me organize my whole study week. The live sessions make it easy to ask questions the moment I get stuck.
feedback.review2Body: The lessons are clear and structured. I finally understand topics I used to struggle with for months.
feedback.review3Body: I love tracking my progress after every quiz — it keeps me motivated to keep going every week.
feedback.review4Body: Between the recorded lessons and live revision, I feel genuinely ready for the BAC this year.
